_about: Optional overrides for the NPC spawn filter (ENABLE_NPC_SPAWN_FILTER). Copy to npc-spawn-filter.json. Every key is optional; a missing file means the built-in defaults. Guide: docs/technical/NPC_SPAWN_FILTER.md
_about_safeRadius: A peaceful NPC is only disabled when no online player is within this many game units of it (another cell counts as far away). 5000 is about 70 m.
_about_disableOnFirstSight: true = disable a peaceful NPC as soon as it first streams in near a player, even inside safeRadius. Fewer people ever see a civilian, but someone might see one vanish.
_about_removeMixedLeveledLists: A leveled list that can roll either a hostile or a peaceful NPC is kept by default (false). Only matters when the server cannot report the actor's resolved template chain.
_about_extraHostileFactionDescs: Factions to add to the built-in hostile list, as 'formIdHex:Plugin.esp' (never a bare numeric FormID: the top byte depends on load order).
_about_overrides: Per-record overrides for the NPC_ base record ('baseDesc' of the actor, see /npcfilter why <hex id>).
